promptSpec.promptText:
Synthesize a low-frame 3D humanoid skeletal animation clip for "Vincent Graves" (Detective Clerk) in a late-1970s mystery hotel.
Target Gesture: GoogleAI_Idle_Observe_Scan (idle_observe) · Cycle Duration: 2.5s · Step Rate: 8 FPS (20 keyframes).
Motion Directive: Subtle breathing chest rise, slow watchful head pan across the hotel corridor, micro-shifts in shoulder stance.
Synchronized 3D Facial Expression: suspicious. Locked Voice/Demeanor: Measured, smoky noir baritone (1970s Classic New York Noir accent, Calm, observant, unhurried detective cadence).
Output upright external-rig-compatible Euler angles (radians) for pelvis, lumbar/thoracic spine, neck, head, clavicles, upper arms, forearms, hands, thighs, calves, and feet.

idle_observe.motionPrompt: Subtle breathing chest rise, slow watchful head pan across the hotel corridor, micro-shifts in shoulder stance.

pace_corridor.motionPrompt: Measured bipedal hotel corridor walking stride with natural arm counter-swing and attentive head pitch.

inspect_ledger.motionPrompt: Attentive upper-body lean over desk register, right forearm tracing entries, subtle head nod and brow furrow.

wall_listen.motionPrompt: Conspiratorial lateral head tilt toward hollow brick partition, raised hand near ear, tense stillness.

parlor_social.motionPrompt: Expressive conversational forearm and wrist gestures, poised head tilt, guarded parlor demeanor.

sleepwalk_trance.motionPrompt: Hypnotic swaying torso drift, partially raised forearms, entranced head pitch toward basement shaft.
